main_text.p: rino. De Abrahami Ecchellensis Bibli-is Syriacis. Deinde laudat propositum de scribenda sacra rituum Ecclesiasticorum antiqvitate.
LXIII. Card. Barberinus J. Morino. Libri Celloti prolixa ea qvæ paulò acrior critice; qvi sit antiqvus & nuperus curiarum Franciæ stylus in iis, de qvibus agit Cellotus.
LXIV. J. Morinus Card. Barberino scribit in favorem translationis Episcopi Carnutensis in Archiepiscopatum Rhemensem.
LXV. J. Morinus Card. Barb. scribit in favorem Domini de Marca ad Episcopatum Coseranensem denominati.
LXVI. Bartholdus Nihusius Jo. Morino dubia qvædam de rebūs Ecclesiasticis.

LXVII. Abraham Ecchellensis Jo. Morino mittit capita Epitomes constitutionum Ecclesiæ Maronitarum, qvæ leguntur Syriacè in eorum Ecclesiis, & controversæ habentur in Lingvam Arabicam; modus administrandi Sacramenti poenitentiæ apud eosdem Maronitas;

page.notes: The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The hook-shaped line-end marks after "Archiepiscopatum" and "in" are printer's continuation signs and are read as the full words. Marks such as "Biblis" and "Cellotus" are as printed. The text is a page of summaries of letters.
